package a2a

import (
	"context"

	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/application/usecases"
)

// Reads is the seam the A2A agent is built over.
type Reads interface {
	Robot(ctx context.Context, id string) (usecases.FleetView, error)
	Fleet(ctx context.Context, id string) (usecases.FleetView, error)
}

// Agent answers read skills only.
type Agent struct{ reads Reads }

// NewAgent builds the agent.
func NewAgent(r Reads) *Agent { return &Agent{reads: r} }
